---
applyTo: "android/feature-workout/**"
---

# feature-workout module instructions

## Purpose and scope

- `android/feature-workout` is the gym/training feature library ("Academia") used only by the `:app` application module. It owns body-measurement history (peso/altura), the exercise catalog, user-assembled workouts (Treino A/B/C…, unlimited) and one private daily diet per account.
- It is an Android library without product flavors. Build and test it with `.\gradlew.bat -p android :feature-workout:compileDebugKotlin` and `.\gradlew.bat -p android :feature-workout:testDebugUnitTest`.

## Structure

- Kotlin packages stay under `com.vfdeginformatica.mysuperapp...` (matching `:app`) even though the Gradle namespace is `com.vfdeginformatica.feature.workout`. Do not change package names; app-side DI, imports and navigation depend on them.
- Layering (same as `feature-financial`):
  - `data/remote/datasource` — Firestore DAOs `BodyMeasurementDao`, `ExerciseDao`, `WorkoutDao` and their `*Impl` (constructor receives `FirebaseFirestore`). Writes use explicit field maps; reads use `toObject(Dto::class.java)`.
  - `data/remote/dto` — `BodyMeasurementDto`, `ExerciseDto`, `WorkoutDto` + nested `WorkoutItemDto`.
  - `data/remote/repository` — `*RepositoryImpl` wrapping DAOs; they map DTO↔domain so repositories and use cases only see domain models.
  - `data/mapper` — `BodyMeasurementMapper`, `ExerciseMapper`, `WorkoutMapper` (`toModel`/`toDto`).
  - `domain/model` — `BodyMeasurement` (computed `bmi`), `Exercise` (computed `videoId`), `MuscleGroup` (fixed enum with pt-BR `label`), `Workout`, `WorkoutItem`, `WeekDay`, `YouTubeVideo` (pure-Kotlin parser: `parseVideoId`, `canonicalUrl`, `embedUrl`).
  - `domain/use_case/workout/{body_measurement,exercise,workout}` — use cases returning `Flow<Resource<T>>` (Loading → Success/Error) built on the `readFlow`/`writeFlow` helpers in `ResourceFlows.kt`.
  - `presentation/common` — `WorkoutFormatters` (dates incl. `formatWeekDay`, kg/cm, IMC, decimal/int input sanitizers), `SessionComponents` (`SessionStatsRow`: duration/calories chips shared by `workout_view` and `workout_hub`), `WeightChart` (Canvas line chart, no external lib) and `YouTubePlayer` / `YouTubePlayerDialog` (16:9 `WebView` running the official YouTube IFrame embed. The wrapper page is loaded with `YouTubeVideo.EMBED_ORIGIN` (the app's Firebase Hosting origin) as base URL and `origin=` param — YouTube rejects embeds without a valid `Referer` with "vídeo indisponível" 152-x/153, and `youtube.com` itself is not accepted. Non-embed links such as "Assistir no YouTube" are opened externally via `ACTION_VIEW`; the player's fullscreen button is honoured through `WebChromeClient.onShowCustomView` (handy for Shorts). Paused/resumed with the host lifecycle and destroyed on release — no YouTube SDK, no download).
  - `presentation/screen/<screen>` — `*Route.kt`, `*Screen.kt`, `*ViewModel.kt` and `contract/` (`UiState`, `Event`, `Effect`). Screens: `workout_hub` (view-mode list of workouts + highlighted shortcut cards "Minha dieta", "Meus dados físicos" and "Histórico de treinos"), `workout_history` (30-day session history grouped by day), `workout_view` (read-only workout + session log), `body_measurement_list`, `body_measurement_detail`, `exercise_list`, `exercise_detail`, `workout_list`, `workout_detail` (editing).

## Dependencies and wiring

- Depends on `:feature-qrcode` only for `common.Resource` and `AppScaffold` (same caveat as `feature-financial`: a future `:core` module is the natural home for those).
- Hilt wiring is app-local: `android/app/di/DaoModule.kt` and `RepositoryModule.kt` provide the feature DAOs/repositories. Use cases are `@Inject constructor` and need no module.
- Routes live in the shared `Screen` sealed class (`feature-qrcode/.../Screen.kt`): `workout_hub_screen`, `workout_history_screen`, `workout_view_screen/{workoutId}` (required id), `body_measurement_list_screen`, `body_measurement_detail_screen?measurementId={measurementId}`, `exercise_list_screen`, `exercise_detail_screen?exerciseId={exerciseId}`, `workout_list_screen`, `workout_detail_screen?workoutId={workoutId}`. Detail screens read the optional id from `SavedStateHandle` (blank/absent = create mode). The nav graph entries are in `android/app/.../MySuperApp.kt`.
- Entry points: Home card "Academia" (`HomeViewModel`, `passwordRequired = false`) → hub = **view mode** (list of workouts → `workout_view`: no add/delete/reorder of exercises, but tapping an item edits its séries/reps/carga/descanso and saves right away; plus session logging); drawer section "Academia" with "Dados físicos" / "Exercícios" / "Treinos" (`AppDrawerMenuRoute`, `navigateWithBiometric(..., passwordRequired = false)`) = **edit mode** (`workout_list`/`workout_detail`). Unlike the financial section, no biometric prompt is required.

## Data model (Firestore, top-level collections; diet is private, other gym data is auth-only)

- `diets/{uid}`: a single daily diet per account, readable/writable only by that account (`isSelf` in `web/firestore.rules`; collection listing is denied). Fields: `meals` (ordered list of `{id, name, time, notes, foods: [{id, name, quantity}]}`), `notes`, `updatedAt` (server timestamp). `time` is optional `HH:mm` (blank = absent); `quantity` is required free text, not a parsed number. List position determines order; IDs remain stable while moving/editing. No separate food catalog or subcollections, no day-of-week/macros/consumption tracking. Empty diets and meals are valid; meal names and food name/quantity are required. Rules validate top-level fields/types; domain use cases validate meal/food fields.
  - `DietDaoImpl` receives `FirebaseAuth` and Firestore, reads the current account's deterministic document, and checks the loaded owner before writes. `DietRecord` distinguishes missing diet (`diet == null`) from read errors; do not feed this through `readFlow`, which interprets null as failure.
  - `GetDietUseCase` observes authentication changes. Both diet ViewModels clear state on account changes; the editor also ignores stale write results. Do not cache a diet in a singleton or save an old account's draft to a new account.
  - `diet_view_screen` (`diet_view` Route/Screen/ViewModel) is strictly read-only; `diet_detail_screen` (`diet_detail`) edits the same document, with explicit whole-diet Save and confirmed deletion. Diet models/DTOs/mappers/DAO/repository follow the usual layers; use cases live in `domain/use_case/workout/diet`.

- `body_measurements/{id}`: `weightKg: number`, `heightCm: number`, `measuredAt: timestamp` (date of the weigh-in, stored at local start of day), `notes: string`, `createdAt` (server). One document per weigh-in → history. `GetBodyMeasurementsUseCase` returns newest first.
- `exercises/{id}`: `name` (required, non-empty), `muscleGroup` (enum name or `""`; unknown names map to `OTHER`, blank maps to `null`), `description`, `notes`, `videoUrl` (canonical `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>` or `""`; legacy documents without the field read as `""`), `createdAt`.
- `workouts/{id}`: `name` (required), `dayOfWeek` (`MONDAY`…`SUNDAY` or `null`), `items: list<map>` (ordered; each `exerciseId`, `order`, optional `sets`, `reps` (free text like `"10-12"`), `loadKg`, `restSeconds`, `notes`), `exerciseIds: list<string>`, `notes`, `icon` (`WorkoutIcon` enum name, e.g. `CARDIO`/`SOCCER`/`BIKE`; missing/unknown → `DUMBBELL`; shown in hub, history and chosen via `WorkoutIconPicker`), `isOther` (`bool`, missing → `false`; set by the "Agrupar em Outros" switch in `workout_detail`, moves the workout out of the hub's main list into the collapsible "Outros (N)" group), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`.
  - **Invariant:** `exerciseIds` is always derived from `items` in `Workout.toDto()` (never set by hand) so `WorkoutDao.getWorkoutsUsingExercise` can use `whereArrayContains("exerciseIds", id)`. `order` is re-indexed from list position on save and on read.
  - The same exercise may appear more than once in a workout; an item whose exercise no longer exists is rendered as "Exercício removido".
- `workout_sessions/{id}`: `workoutId: string` (required), `date: timestamp` (day of the gym visit, local start of day), `durationMinutes: int | null`, `calories: int | null`, `createdAt` (server; exposed on the domain model as `WorkoutSession.createdAt: Instant?` only to order same-day sessions). Add/delete only (no update). Queried per workout with `whereEqualTo("workoutId", id)` (`GetWorkoutSessionsUseCase`, newest first in memory) and across workouts with `whereGreaterThanOrEqualTo("date", from)` (`WorkoutSessionDao.getSessionsSince` → `GetRecentWorkoutSessionsUseCase`, default 30 days, ordered `date` desc then `createdAt` desc; single-field query, no composite index). Non-positive stats are read as `null`. Deleting a workout does **not** cascade to its sessions (the hub shows them as "Treino removido").
- Rules are in `web/firestore.rules` (`body_measurements`, `exercises`, `workouts`, `workout_sessions`). Deploy with `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` from `web\`.
- Diet access also requires publishing the new `diets` rules to the matching Firebase project before use. Do not deploy automatically. Diets are private and are **not** copied by `copy:workout-data`.
- To replicate the catalog and workouts between Firebase projects (dev `my-super-app-dev-d6819` → prd `baila-675c6`) use `npm --prefix web\functions run copy:workout-data -- --dry-run` / without `--dry-run` (`web/functions/scripts/copyWorkoutData.js`). It copies `exercises` then `workouts` preserving document IDs and overwrites existing ones; sessions and measurements are not copied.

## Business rules

- Body measurement validation (ViewModel): weight > 0 and ≤ 500 kg, height between 50 and 300 cm, date not in the future; decimal inputs accept comma or dot (`parseDecimal`). In create mode the height is prefilled from the latest record.
- Exercise: name required; a duplicate name (case-insensitive) only shows a warning. **Deleting an exercise that is referenced by any workout is blocked** (`DeleteExerciseUseCase` emits `Resource.Error` listing the workout names); the detail screen disables the delete button and explains which workouts use it.
- Exercise video: at most one YouTube link per exercise (`videoUrl`). The ViewModel accepts any shape `YouTubeVideo.parseVideoId` understands (`watch?v=`, `youtu.be/`, `shorts/`, `embed/`, `live/`, with or without scheme, extra params ignored); a non-blank value that does not parse shows `VIDEO_URL_INVALID_ERROR` and disables save. On save the URL is normalized with `YouTubeVideo.canonicalUrl`. The detail screen renders `YouTubePlayer` inline as soon as the link is valid; the workout screen shows a ▶ button on items whose exercise has a video (`WorkoutItemRow.videoId`) and opens `YouTubePlayerDialog` (`WorkoutDetailUiState.playingVideo`). Downloading YouTube videos is intentionally not supported (ToS).
- Workout: name required; items are optional (an empty workout can be saved and filled later); there is no limit on the number of workouts. Reordering is done with ▲/▼ buttons; item prescription (séries/repetições/carga/descanso/observação) is edited in a dialog and is optional.
- `GetWorkoutsUseCase` orders by `dayOfWeek` (unscheduled last) then name.
- Hub grouping (`WorkoutHubUiState`): `mainWorkouts` = workouts with `isOther == false`, `otherWorkouts` = `isOther == true`. When `otherWorkouts` is non-empty the hub renders a clickable "Outros (N)" header right below the main list (before the Dieta/Dados físicos/Histórico cards); `WorkoutHubEvent.OthersToggled` flips `isOthersExpanded` (UI-only, starts collapsed) and the expanded group reuses `WorkoutCard`. The header is hidden when no workout is flagged. The drawer's `workout_list` and `workout_history` do not group by this flag.
- Workout session (`WorkoutViewViewModel`, `AddWorkoutSessionUseCase.validateSession`): only the date is required and it cannot be in the future (`DATE_FUTURE_ERROR`); duration is in minutes, 1–600 (`DURATION_INVALID_ERROR`); calories 1–5000 (`CALORIES_INVALID_ERROR`); both optional (blank → `null`). Numeric inputs are sanitized to digits only (3/4 chars). `WorkoutViewUiState` reuses `WorkoutItemRow`/`WorkoutDetailUiState.prescriptionOf` for the read-only rows and exposes `lastSession`, `totalMinutes`, `totalCalories`.
- Hub history (`WorkoutHistoryViewModel`, `workout_history_screen`, opened from the hub's "Histórico de treinos" card): `WorkoutHistoryUiState.historyDays` groups the recent sessions by `date` (order preserved from the use case) into `WorkoutHistoryDay` → `WorkoutHistoryEntry(session, workoutName)`; `workoutName == null` means the workout was deleted. Tapping an entry navigates to `workout_view` when the workout exists, otherwise shows `WORKOUT_REMOVED_MESSAGE`; the trash icon deletes with the same confirm flow as `workout_view`. Sessions are only *registered* from `workout_view`. `WorkoutHubViewModel` itself only loads the workouts and emits navigation effects (`NavigateToDiet` / `NavigateToBodyMeasurements` / `NavigateToHistory` / `NavigateToWorkout`).

## How to use (user flow)

1. Home → "Academia" shows "Meus treinos" (workouts not flagged as "Outros"), then — only when some workout has the flag — a collapsed "Outros (N)" title that expands/collapses on tap to reveal those workouts, and, below it, three highlighted cards: **Minha dieta**, **Meus dados físicos** (opens the same `body_measurement_list` screen as the drawer's "Dados físicos") and **Histórico de treinos**. The history card opens `workout_history_screen` ("Histórico (últimos 30 dias)"): one header per day (date + week day) with a card per logged session (workout name, minutes, kcal; several cards when you trained more than once that day). Tap a card to open that workout, trash icon to delete the log. Tap a workout in the hub to open the **view screen**: exercises with séries/repetições/carga/descanso as chips and ▶ for videos, plus the session history. Tap an exercise to adjust its prescription (`ItemDraftDialog` from `presentation/common/ItemDraftEditor.kt`, shared with `workout_detail`); the change is persisted immediately via `SaveWorkoutUseCase`. Adding/removing/reordering exercises is not possible here — use the drawer. FAB "Registrar treino" opens a dialog with date (today by default), minutes in the gym and calories; trash icon on a session row deletes it (with confirmation).
2. Drawer → Academia → **Exercícios** → `+` to register exercises (name, muscle group chips, description, notes, optional YouTube link — the video plays right below the field). Edit/delete by tapping an item.
3. Drawer → Academia → **Treinos** → `+` → name (e.g. "Treino A"), optional week day, icon (predefined chips), switch **Agrupar em Outros** (keeps the workout out of the hub's main list, under the collapsible "Outros" title), "Adicionar" to pick exercises from the catalog, reorder with the arrows, tap an item to set sets/reps/load/rest, tap ▶ to watch the exercise video. Save. Repeat for B, C, … as needed.
4. Drawer → Academia → **Dados físicos** → `+` to record weight/height/date/notes. The list shows deltas vs. the previous record, IMC and a weight chart; tap a row to edit, trash icon to delete.
5. Home → Academia → **Minha dieta** (first highlighted card below the workouts, followed by "Meus dados físicos" and "Histórico de treinos") opens strictly read-only daily meals, times, observations and food quantities. It is a highlighted card with the Restaurant icon (also used for Dieta in the drawer), distinct from workout cards and separated from them by a divider; there are no section titles above the shortcut cards. These cards stay available even without workouts or while they load. With no diet, the screen explains where to register one.
6. Drawer → Academia → **Dieta** opens the editor directly, without biometrics. Add/remove meals and foods; arrows reorder either list independently of meal times. Name meals freely, enter optional `HH:mm` and notes, and use quantities such as "entre 120 e 160 g", "2 fatias" or "meia unidade". Nothing is persisted until **Salvar dieta**; a failed save retains the draft. Loading failures block editing until retry succeeds. **Excluir dieta** confirms before removing the whole document.

## Tests

- Unit tests live in `src/test` (JUnit4 + `kotlinx-coroutines-test`, `StandardTestDispatcher` + `Dispatchers.setMain`, hand-written fakes in `domain/repository/Fake*Repository.kt`). Cover mappers, `DeleteExerciseUseCase`, UiState computations and ViewModel validation/save flows when changing behavior.
- Diet tests cover ordered round trips/free quantities, empty documents versus errors, required fields/time validation, explicit save/retry, confirmed deletion, consultation reload without writes and clearing/ignoring stale results across account changes.
- `src/androidTest/.../diet/DietScreensTest.kt` uses the repository's existing Compose test libraries with fictitious state (no Firebase account): verifies the diet card's position/accessibility in an empty/loading hub, consultation without editable controls, and editing/deletion confirmation. Run `:feature-workout:connectedDebugAndroidTest` with an Android device/emulator.
